_note: GOLD RULES - the ONE machine-readable control site for every AntCV generation (owner 2026-07-13). Narrative + enforcement map: docs/qa/GOLD_STANDARD_LOCKER.md. Consumers: pwa/antcv-bullet-targets.js (prompt block on every generation/Fit-it/Enhance call), scripts/job-tracker/{quality_pass,density_fit,measure_density,gen-runner}.py (persist + sweep enforcement). Served at antcv.pages.dev/gold-rules.json so workers can fetch it (proxy prompt-augment wiring = open follow-up). Change values HERE; code reads them.

results.rule: a Results line needs a QUANTIFIED OUTCOME OR SCOPE (change metric, or number+object of an action verb like '100 users across 150 machines'); digits that only DESCRIBE the role context (team size, site counts, years) do not qualify
results.descriptors_are_bullets: team sizes, site names, headcounts and years are role bullets, never Results

impact_types._doc: RESULTS-IMPACT-TYPES-001 (owner 2026-10-01, from the Improve Academy slide 'Using result-oriented language: looking for impact'): every Results line and achievement bullet is one of four impact types. Per job, the type the JD asks for most gets extra weight when a role's bullets and Results line are chosen. JD relevance stays the primary key (EVIDENCE-RANK-002); motivation lines are untouched. Consumers: scripts/job-tracker/gen-runner.py (_impact_types, _jd_impact_demand, _fit_role), quality_pass.py (rule_results_numeric), pwa/antcv-docx-client.js (_impactNorm in _rankScore), prompt_block.

prompt_block: GOLD CONTENT RULES (hard requirements):
- Every Results line states a CHANGE metric (a percentage, multiplier, from->to, time/volume/money delta) with its mechanism. A team size or site description is a bullet, never a Result.
- Core-competency tables: 3-4 TABLE ROWS, the highest-impact ones; every cell a complete clause that RENDERS in at most two lines of its column - never a third line.
- Professional-experience roles: at most 3 bullets per role (generation cap) - pick the strongest; never pad.
- Table first-column labels stay SHORT (about 28 chars max): a label that wraps to three lines or one-word rows in its cell is invalid; compress the label instead.
- Every bullet and sentence ends COMPLETE with terminal punctuation - never a dangling connector or preposition ("...traceable from"), never a cut enumeration ("...optics, electronics, mechanical.").
- Name partner/client companies only when the job description itself signals them; otherwise describe the relationship ("an ODM partner").
- Certificates carry no years; order them by relevance to this job.
- Interests and sidebar one-liners stay compact (drop filler words); keep personality lines intact but never pad them.

- EVIDENCE RANKING (EVIDENCE-RANK-002): with a JD present, JD-exact evidence is the PRIMARY sort key, not a tie-breaker; a rare, specific JD requirement the candidate genuinely covers (an automated optical test setup, a named lab technique) outranks generic transferable evidence (project management, stakeholder communication) regardless of impact. Impact orders items only within the same relevance tier.

- SOURCE-BACKED PHRASES (COMPOUND-BACKED-001): every technical noun-compound ("thermal packaging", "test correlation", "sign-off gates") must appear as a CONNECTED concept in the candidate source; never synthesise a new competency because its words occur separately in the kernel. When in doubt, use the kernel's own wording verbatim.

- METRIC MEANING (METRIC-SEMANTIC-001): keep every metric bound to what it measured, in the source's own terms - a "change cycle cut from roughly 250 days to about 10" must never become "late-stage rework reduced 95%"; prefer the source's raw numbers over derived percentages.
- CONSISTENCY (CONTRADICTION-QA-001): stated years of experience, team sizes and scale figures must match the kernel exactly and be identical everywhere they appear across the CV and cover letter.

- COVER LETTER LENGTH (CL-LENGTH-001): 350-450 words total on one page - a compact opening tied to THIS role, three evidence paragraphs, a short close. Never assume the employer has gaps or problems; never open with a generic "roles where..." line.

- EVERY experience role carries its own Results line (ROLE-RESULTS-MANDATORY-001): the role's strongest REAL outcome in the source's own terms; a role without a Results line is an incomplete generation.

- RESULT IMPACT TYPES (RESULTS-IMPACT-TYPES-001, owner 2026-10-01): write every Results line and achievement bullet as ONE of four impact types: PERFORMANCE (what increased, decreased or improved: time, cost, quality, efficiency, delivery, with its number), DELIVERABLES (what was created or completed: a product, plan, process, system, workshop series or report, with a count or scope), IMPROVEMENTS (what works better: faster, clearer, easier, standardised) or AUDIENCE (who benefited and at what scale: users, customers, teams, sites, countries). Per job, the type the job description asks for most gets weight when you choose a role's bullets and Results line (cost and schedule language favours PERFORMANCE; build and launch language favours DELIVERABLES; process language favours IMPROVEMENTS; customer, user and market language favours AUDIENCE). JD relevance (EVIDENCE-RANK-002) still ranks first and motivation lines stay as they are. Spread the types across roles so the CV shows more than one kind of impact; never invent a number or a scale to fit a type.

- TRACKMAN IS AN INTERNSHIP (ROLE-BODY-NOTE-001, owner 2026-10-01): the Trackman role's body makes clear it is an internship (for example the first bullet label reads 'Hardware Project Management (internship):'); the role line itself (title, company, years) stays unchanged.

- SKILLS (SKILLS-GROUPED-001, owner 2026-10-01): do not go overboard on skills; keep them few and grouped: hard skills in the Core Competencies table and Tools & Methods, soft skills in the 'Work style:' line, never one long mixed list.

- HOUSE SECTIONS ARE MANDATORY (HOUSE-SECTIONS-001): a commercial CV always carries Profile, 'Work style:' line, the Core Competencies table (Focus Area | Strategic Expertise), Experience, Education, and the sidebar set (Tools & Methods, Certificates, Languages, Interests - all six items - and Accessibility). Never drop a house section to hit a length target; compress WITHIN sections instead.

- ACCESSIBILITY LINE (owner 2026-09-03, supersedes 2026-08-16): 'Hearing impaired; clear spoken communication and written follow-ups work well.' - the full line, never a bare 'Hearing impaired.' It belongs in the CV only; a cover letter carries no hearing line.

- SLOGAN FUSION (SLOGAN-PERSONALITY-IMPACT-001): the positioning line fuses IMPACT with the candidate's PERSONALITY - prefer a word that carries both the temperament and the craft (gold: 'AN ELECTRO-OPTICS ENGINEER WHO TURNS MEASURED LIGHT INTO SHIPPED PRODUCT' - 'measured' is both the work style and the metrology).

- GREETING (CL-GREETING-001): the cover letter ALWAYS opens with a greeting to the hiring manager - BY NAME when the JD, the recruiter search or the application notes provide one ('Dear Firstname Lastname,'), else 'Dear Hiring Team,' (localised). A letter without a greeting is an incomplete generation.

- TARGET ROLE (TARGET-ROLE-001, owner 2026-09-29, Veo): meta.role is the title of the POSTING itself - the posting header or the 'we are looking for a <title>' line. A title the JD names as a partner, manager or neighbouring team ('you will partner with our Director of Hardware Engineering', 'reporting to the Head of X') is NEVER the target role. When the pasted text has no header, take the title whose responsibilities the JD describes as 'you will...'.

- EXAMPLE ISOLATION (EXAMPLE-ISOLATION-001, owner 2026-09-29): examples inside these instructions were written for OTHER employers and roles (Aimpoint, NKT Photonics, Sigma Connectivity, HBK, Novo Nordisk ...). Copy their SHAPE only - never their company names, role titles, products, activities or phrases. The only employer and role in the output are the ones in the JOB DESCRIPTION, and every statement about the employer must come from the JD text.

- STORED FACTS STAY AS STORED (STORED-FACTS-001, owner 2026-09-27): two stored roles at the same company with different titles or date ranges are NEVER merged into one role and never get a fused title; education entries stay separate (two degrees taken in parallel are two entries, never 'Dual B.Sc.' or 'B.Sc. X & B.Sc. Y'); language levels, publication counts and team sizes are copied exactly from the source; the candidate's current role (newest start date, 'present') is listed first.

- PLACEMENT NOTES (PLACEMENT-NOTES-001): obey placement notes stored on a kernel item (e.g. 'promote to an experience ROLE when the employer is sports-tech / people / community-oriented, otherwise the INTERESTS line') - the note decides the section, not the model.

- WORDING 2026-09-27 (BANNED-0927): collaborative -> team-based, cross-functional -> multi-disciplinary, end-to-end -> from start to finish, 'leading' as a verb -> running; keep the original capitalisation. Standards are cited by name, never by clause number (ISO 9001, not 8.3/8.4). A 'no ties to Russia' sentence appears only when the ad explicitly asks for it.

- VALUE FOR THIS POSITION (VALUE-FOR-ROLE-001, owner 2026-10-01; holds for EVERY writing style and layout, Copenhagen and Nordic Minimal included, and OVERRIDES any earlier PROFILE or CORE COMPETENCIES instruction it conflicts with): the PROFILE and the CORE COMPETENCIES table must make it obvious HOW the candidate creates value in THIS position - what the employer gets, in the employer's own terms from the JD, backed by a real result from the source.

- PROFILE (VALUE-FOR-ROLE-001): sentence 1 = the identity that fits the role; sentence 2 = the VALUE sentence - the outcome he delivers for this employer's product, problem or goal as the JD names it, with ONE real proof point from the source in its own terms (a metric, a shipped product, a shortened cycle); the last sentence stays the behaviour-based people and communication close. When the length cap bites, drop the energy sentence, never the value sentence.

- CORE COMPETENCIES (VALUE-FOR-ROLE-001): 3-4 rows chosen from the JD's top needs, not generic standing areas. Focus Area = that need in a few of the JD's own words (about 25 chars max). Strategic Expertise = what he delivers on that need plus the proof, as ONE compact clause (value, then evidence; shape only: 'Changes decided fast and kept on budget; cycle cut from ~250 to ~10 days') - never a bare keyword or standards list. The cell still renders in at most two lines of its column and ends without a full stop. The cover letter WHAT I BRING table takes DIFFERENT JD needs - split the needs between the two tables, never duplicate a Focus Area.
- Without a JD (unsolicited): apply the same value framing to the candidate's target-role family (VALUE-FOR-ROLE-001).

- PROFILE VOICE, FROM ME TO THEM (PROFILE-VOICE-001, owner 2026-10-01; OVERRIDES any older PROFILE instruction it conflicts with, incl. the BODY-MIND energy sentence): write profile_content with "I" ("I am", "I will", "my"), never third person and never subject-less CV fragments ("Experienced engineer with..."). The OPENING sentence is personal: introduce the candidate by role ("I am a <role> who <what I do>, with <1-2 real results>"). EVERY sentence after it turns to the COMPANY: what they do or face, in the JD's terms ("<Company>'s <team> builds X, where Y"), then "As <Company>'s <role> I will <method>" with the outcome for them and one real proof point. NEVER address the reader as "you": no "You get...", "Your engineers get...", "As your <role>" (owner 2026-10-01: "I" instead of "You"; this holds for every profile part, How I Work included). Name the target company; describe past work by product, not by employer names the reader will not know. NEVER self-focused motivation: no "I'm excited", "I enjoy", "I'm motivated by", "I'm drawn to", "I thrive", "I want to develop", "passionate". Without a JD: keep the personal opening and turn to the kind of team the candidate helps, same bans.

- PROFILE IS NEVER A BUZZWORD LIST (PROFILE-NO-BUZZWORD-LIST-001, owner 2026-10-01): every profile sentence has a subject and a real verb and names something concrete (a product, a decision, a result). Never stack 3+ adjectives, trait labels or abstract nouns joined by commas, slashes or bullets ("Results-driven, detail-oriented, strategic leader"; "Stakeholder management, risk, agile, delivery"). Banned in the profile: results-driven, detail-oriented, self-starter, dynamic, proactive, innovative, motivated, passionate, team player, strong communicator, track record, proven ability, synergy. Test: if a sentence could sit in any other candidate's CV, rewrite it as a behaviour or a result.

- PROFILE HEADING SLOGAN (PROFILE-SLOGAN-001, owner 2026-10-01): return cv_overrides.profile_slogan - the slogan part of the CV profile HEADING, which renders as "Profile: <slogan>" (e.g. "Profile: Make the case before the spec") so it still reads as the profile section; return the slogan only, without the word Profile. 3-8 words, a headline (no full stop), in the output language, showing you know what THIS employer needs: their product + their need (shape only: 'Make the case before the spec', 'From first prototype to quantum delivery'). It MUST NOT repeat the cover-letter slogan (meta.cl_slogan): share NO content word with it (ignore a/the/of/and/with/for/to/in) and take a different angle - the cl_slogan says who the candidate is to them, the profile_slogan says what their product or team needs. Not a bare job title, not a skills list. Without a JD: the kind of work the candidate does best, in a few words.

roles._note: ROLE CONTROL (owner 2026-07-13 'make sure your work fits in the golden gating matrix role control ... I want also danish spanish and chinese canon'). Identity: the stable canonical role id is the LANGUAGE-AGNOSTIC identity (SAME-ID 1.51.353, BASE-ID + GEN-ID 1.51.358) - a suffixed backfill twin (<id>-2) or a gen schema id (r1..) at the same company/tenure is the SAME position; exactly ONE role per canonical id survives dedupe, canonical id wins (the Results pins key on it). Titles: per-language RENDERINGS of that identity come from canon_titles below - deterministic, so LLM title drift can never fork a position across languages. Enforced by antcv-sections-normalize-415.js roleCanonTitles (runs after dedupe on en/da/es/zh ribbons; he/am/ar keep the translate output); mirror-drift gated by pwa/test/unit/gold-role-canon.test.mjs. A merged title with MORE '&'-segments than the canon (deliberate merge-or-split structure) is never overwritten.

sidebar_compact._doc: TOOLS-SIDEBAR-COMPRESS-001 (register row 26, owner 2026-07-03, gold from the unsolicited export screenshot). ITEM-LEVEL synonym/trim for the TOOLS & METHODS sidebar Instruments / Lab & fabrication comma-lists ONLY - scoped by the item's lead label so main-column prose (e.g. the 'confocal microscopy' Characterisation bullet) is never touched. The block is rich_block: apply to the item VALUE, do NOT convert the block. Acceptance = the sidebar renders the gold text in preview AND PDF. Deterministic consumer belt: pwa/antcv-sidebar-compact-001.js rewrites the stored sections.cv TOOLS rich_block value once (parity: preview + export both read stored sections), idempotent + text-verified. All three rules apply deterministically to the scoped lines (which are inherently long - the owner's 'when tight' justification): token_subs are unconditional phrase swaps; drop_token_when_sibling drops standalone SEM when HRSEM is a sibling and collapses HRSEM/SEM->HRSEM; trim_trailing_word strips a redundant trailing word (label already carries it). Reordering to the exact gold token order is the SEPARATE packing belt (rule 40, antcv-orphan-export-preflight.js).
